newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - LucasVarity outlines div policy.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - LucasVarity outlines div policy.

text.p: Anglo-American engineering group LucasVarity Plc said on Tuesday it envisaged a "continuing programme" of share buybacks and dividend growth in a bid to satisfy its investors on both sides of the Atlantic.
Victor Rice, chief executive, said in an interview with Reuters: "We expect to see the dividend increase each year in line with profits and continuing share buybacks."

He added that the dividend plus share buyback for the year to January 31, 1997, represented a 50 percent increase on the previous distribution available to investors before the merger of Lucas Industries and Varity Corp last September.
Turning to the impact of a strong pound on the group, Rice said the effect was "not significant" in last year's results.
He added that he was also "fairly relaxed" about the impact this year, saying it would not be great.
